faq.q: What dilution ratios do you recommend?
faq.a: Typical topical dilutions range from 0.5–3% for roll-ons and short-term topical use. We follow conservative recommendations tailored to age and sensitivity.

faq.q: How do I do a patch test?
faq.a: Apply a small diluted amount to an inner forearm and wait 24 hours. If redness or irritation occurs, discontinue use and contact your practitioner.

faq.q: Are essential oils safe around pets?
faq.a: Many oils can affect animals. We provide pet-aware guidance and suggest good ventilation, low diffuser time, and avoiding direct application to pets. Consult a veterinarian for specific concerns.
We prioritize safety. Certain oils and concentrations are avoided during pregnancy and breastfeeding; we select options and provide alternatives when appropriate.
